from:
A failed request is reported in the result, not
as an error, so branch on `result.ok`.
why: T1/T2: the reviewers' attack: a shared sentence dropped from every REFERENCE of a port. lua (style pair, shared with go) gave PASS with 'absent 36 (35 explained)'; perl (die) and swift (wrapped) share their style with no reference, so their absent list was empty and nothing moved from scratch. Must be a new absent entry with no reason, which fails the one command.
